title: Charm City Kings
subtitle: An AR filter campaign for HBO Max's Charm City Kings.
metaPills: Tools: Spark AR, Blender, Adobe CC

overview.label: 01 — Overview
overview.body: For the release of Charm City Kings, HBO Max wanted a way to put fans inside the film's dirt-bike world directly from their phone cameras — no app, no download. The filter turns a marketing beat into something a fan can step into and share.

problem.label: 02 — The Problem
problem.quote: "A trailer only asks you to watch."
problem.body: Standard promo assets ask an audience to sit back; HBO Max wanted something a fan could step inside and share, turning a marketing beat into a moment of participation instead of a passive view.

process.name: Concept & Mood
process.body: Pulled visual language from the film's dirt-bike and Baltimore street culture.

process.name: Effect Design
process.body: Built the AR triggers and overlays in Spark AR and Blender.

process.name: Brand Pass
process.body: Aligned type and metrics to HBO Max's campaign guidelines.

process.name: Test & Publish
process.body: Cross-device testing, then submission to Instagram and Facebook.

finalDesign.label: 05 — Final Design
cards: Front-camera capture of the filter in-use
Effect trigger overlay, built in Spark AR
Placement in an Instagram Stories frame

outcomes.label: 06 — Outcomes
items: Shipped as an official HBO Max campaign filter for Charm City Kings, live on Instagram and Facebook.
Turned a passive trailer moment into a participatory brand touchpoint.

reflection.label: 07 — Reflection
reflection.quote: "A filter lives or dies in the first half second — the challenge wasn't the AR technology, it was making the film's world recognizable instantly, in a format most people scroll straight past."

hero.alt: They call me Holy Savage — filter in-use capture
